classification.difficultyReason: Combine two disc-minus-circular-hole areas from four supplied diameters and supplied pi approximation. Choose subtraction/addition of familiar areas and carry units/rounding; no unfamiliar construction.

content.prompt: Find the approximate area of plastic represented by the shaded region in this piece of jewellery. Use $\pi\approx3.14$. Give your answer to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Two vertically connected circular plastic regions: upper outer diameter30mm with offset15mm circular hole, lower outer diameter40mm with offset20mm hole. Pale-blue material excludes white holes. Both outer diameters and hole arrows retain original givens. Decorative hook omitted, mathematical connector retained.

answer.worked:
Subtract each circular hole from its plastic disc, then add:
$$A\approx3.14\left(15^2-7.5^2+20^2-10^2\right)=3.14(468.75)=1471.875\text{ mm}^2\approx1471.88\text{ mm}^2.$$
